paite: Huan David in alungsim in, Chikchiang hiam a zaw Saul khut a mangthang khongkhong ding ka hi ve. Philistia mite gam a taimang sang a hoihzaw om lou ding ahi. Huchi in Saul in Israel gam a hon zonna alungdong dia, huchi in akhut a pan ka suakta ding," achi hi.
heading: David Philistiate Lak Ah

paite: David athou a, amah leh akiang a mi zaguk omte Maok tapa Gath kumpipa Akish kiang ah apaita uhi.
David leh amite, michih a-inkuankuan un, David zi nihte, Jezreel mi Ahinoam leh Nabal zi Karmel mi Abigailte toh Gath ah Akish kiang ah atengta uhi.
Gath ah David atai chih Saul ahilh ua, huchi in azong nawnta kei hi.

David in Akish kiang ah, "Na mitmuh a deihsakna ka tanleh, na gam a khua khat ah tenna ding mun hon pe sam inla, huai ah ka teng ding uh. Na sikha bang ding in kumpipa khopi ah na kiang ah a-om nilouh dia?" achi hi.
Huchi in Akish in huai ni in Ziklag khua apeta hi. Huaiziak in Ziklag tuni tan in Judah gam kumpipate a ahi nilouh hi.
Philistia gam a David a-om sung kum khat pumpi leh kha li ahi.
David leh amite ava hohtou ua, Geshur mite, Girzi mite leh Amalek mite ava dou uhi. Huai namte Telam a pan Shur gam lam pang Aigupta gam pha a om ahi uhi.
David in gam asual a, numei leh pasal hawi himhim anei kei. Belamte, bawngte, sabiltungte, sangawngsaute leh apuansilhte uh alaksak hi. Apai nawn a, Akish kiang ah ahoh hi.
Akish in, "Tuni in koilam na dou a?" achi hi. David in, "Judah sim gam, Jerahmeelte sim gam leh Kente sim gam," achi hi.
"Philistia gam a a-om sung mawngmawng in 'David in hichibang in ahih zel," achi kha ding ua, chi in numei pasal Gath a pi ding hawi himhim anei kei hi.
Akish in David thugen ataksang a, "Ami Israelte akimudahsak mahmah ziak in, tangtawn in ka sikha ding in a-om ding," achi hi.
